author: vicsansj
quote: Amazing city design and stunning graphics, but unfortunately, that's where the praise ends. The characters are incredibly annoying, the dialogue is exhausting, and the story is so poorly executed that it completely ruins what could otherwise have been an incredible gaming experience.  A beautiful world means very little when the narrative gives you no compelling reason to enjoy spending time in it .And honestly, if you're defending these writing choices simply because the game looks beautiful or because it's critically acclaimed, then your standards are probably much lower than you think. Being visually impressive doesn't automatically make a game well-written.
